title: Story premise ENT026: The Orchestra of One Note Each
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: Everybody knows one note. That is currently the problem. Takeaway/theme: Coordination can make limited contributions useful.
description: Five performers want to play a recognizable original tune, but each instrument can make only one note and everyone enters at once. They turn the score into a moving marker that points to one player at a time, producing a short melody and a deliberately joyful final chord.
